scope: Local release preparation; no repository creation or publication. Runtime and official APK unchanged.

checks.workflowConfiguration: Local JSON-compatible YAML/contract and PowerShell syntax checks passed; no GitHub-hosted run
checks.independentReadOnlyReview: Passed; allowlist, nested baseline integrity, unchanged APK assets and secret/data exclusion reviewed

packageIntegrity: Final source ZIP hash is in source-package-r1-verification.json and the .sha256 sidecar; delivery hashes are in DELIVERY-CHECK.json. Avoids self-referential archive hashes.
limitations: No GitHub-hosted workflow execution or hosted issue-form rendering
No Android emulator/physical-device installation, OEM recorder or document-provider validation
No clinical, native-language clinical, low-resource full-shift or Apple-platform validation
Signing backup is encrypted with a separately stored key and restricted ACLs, but both remain on the same local drive; no off-device recovery copy
Public-file checks are explicit allowlist and credential-indicator checks, not a universal secret-detection guarantee
